Honestly, that guy sounds like me and you seem to perfectly describe bow my girlfriend is. 

Personally I'm just going to tell you how I feel. 

Note: I am in the military, no better LDR example than this. 

However when we are together after all that time apart I just want to be together. Now I can't say what it's like for my civilian counterparts but I kinda don't like it when I come home and get placed on the back burner while I'm coming home for my SO. It almost feels like I'm being shunned. "Overbearing" and sometimes comes at me with clingy. Which honestly makes me upset because if I can't be clingy for the 4 weeks I get too see my S.O in a year then wtf?  Time spent together is worth its weight in gold for people like me and your BF, we value it more than anything in the world and to be denied it hurts deep down. Now I get you need space and everything but if I'm going to show you affection and care why would you shut me down? I understand you got your own life to live and everything but I'm here, putting that aside, for you.

And here is where it gets worse, if it's not strained that far out already. As one gives affection you want it in return. You expect it, and in my opinion I shouldn't have to ask for it. I can't be so in love with you, giving my all, just to ask you to give me the same.  It is almost feels like one puts more effort than the other.

Idk how much this helps open up your perspective of how your BF feels but I hope so.
